verdict.rationale: The SDK provides permission controls (permission modes, rules, and a canUseTool callback) plus hooks that can block dangerous operations, giving a form of least-privilege enforcement over what tools/actions an agent can invoke. However, there is no evidence of a mechanism to actually issue or scope API credentials/keys (e.g., generating restricted-scope tokens for external API access) — the permission system governs tool invocation, not credential issuance. Missing for 10: explicit support for generating/scoping API keys or tokens, credential rotation/expiry controls, and any documentation tying permission rules to external API credential scoping.
